These results have been compiled quarterly and annually by the commune and district FCIM boards 98 of survey participants believe that FCIMs TerraI Forest loss tracking and monitoring system is necessary for current forest management and protection 100 of trainers trained to operate and use the TerraI system for CSOs in the North Central region and Ha Noi confidently rated it at a good level or better

FCIM monitoring report is presented in at least 4 provincial and 2 national forums starting from December 2020 to end of the project. 60 officials at provincial district and commune levels attended the FCIMTerraI workshop. They understood that TerraI application is a suitable and necessary tool to improve the effectiveness of forest management and monitoring of the community. They appreciate the necessity of the FCIM network in sustainable forest management serving the REDD Program 20 districtlevel quarterly meetings and 04 provinciallevel dialogues were organized to discuss the results of the FCIM network with local authorities and stakeholders Opinions are included in the quarterly meeting minutes between the FCIM network and local authorities to carry out activities for the next quarter Terrai map has been updated and expanded to 20 communes of Tuong Duong and Ky Son districts from January 2024. Activities and results of monitoring forest changes in the pilot area of 2 project districts are highly appreciated by the government management agencies and the community The FCIM network and TerraI tool were evaluated by 20 extended commune authorities as suitable and expected to be applied in their forest management.
4 provincial FCIM workshops and 2 national forestry forum were convened for information dissemination and policy advocacy.

comment.narrative: The FCIM network conducts forest change monitoring using the TerraI tool conducts monthly fieldwork and reports monthly monitoring results. These results have been compiled quarterly and annually by the commune and district FCIM boardsThe results of the endofproject evaluation survey showed that All survey participants said that the general and specific goals of the project are consistent with current forest management and protection policies. The majority of survey participants 6566 believed that it is necessary to apply TerraI and the FCIM network to monitor deforestation At the same time it is necessary to expand the monitoring and reporting system by social organizations and local communities.
